criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Lost or Stolen
categories.definition: Reports of lost, stolen, or misplaced cards or phones, and requests to freeze or block accounts to prevent unauthorized access.

categories.name: Card Stuck or Swallowed by ATM
categories.definition: Incidents where a card has been retained, stuck, or swallowed by an ATM machine.

categories.name: Card Ordering and Delivery
categories.definition: Requests to order, replace, or track the delivery of physical or virtual cards, including questions about card types and expiration.

categories.name: Card Activation and PIN
categories.definition: Issues related to activating a card, setting a PIN, unlocking a blocked PIN, or using contactless payment features.

categories.name: Card Payment Declined or Failed
categories.definition: Reports of card payments being declined or failing to process at merchants, online, or ATMs where fraud is not suspected.

categories.name: Card Usage and Acceptance
categories.definition: Questions regarding where the card is accepted, ATM compatibility, and general card functionality limits.

categories.name: Top Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems with adding money to the account, including failed, pending, reverted, or missing top-up transactions.

categories.name: Top Up General Inquiry
categories.definition: General questions about top-up methods, limits, fees, and supported cards or services.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Problems with sending or receiving money transfers, including pending, failed, missing, or reverted transfers.

categories.name: Transfer General Inquiry
categories.definition: General questions about transfer methods, processing times, limits, and supported transfer types.

categories.name: Cash Deposit Issues
categories.definition: Issues specifically regarding cash deposits that are pending, missing, or not reflected in the available balance.

categories.name: Transaction Dispute and Fraud
categories.definition: Reports of unauthorized transactions, duplicate charges, refund requests for merchant disputes, and requests to freeze accounts due to hacking.

categories.name: Exchange Rates and Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Questions about current exchange rates, the basis for rates, and requests to perform or troubleshoot currency exchanges.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about specific fees applied to transactions, withdrawals, or card usage, and disputes regarding unexpected charges.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Issues or questions regarding the process of verifying identity, source of funds, or passing security checks to access the account.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests to open, close, or delete an account, update personal details, or questions regarding account eligibility.

categories.name: App and Passcode Issues
categories.definition: Technical problems accessing the app, resetting passcodes, or using the app without a phone.
